attributes.name: Slaying Bolts
attributes.powers:
Display this card; you may not do this during an encounter. After doing so, if you have more than 2 cards that have the Ammunition trait displayed, recharge 1 of them.

While displayed, when you defeat a monster and would banish it, you may display it next to this card instead. When you play a weapon that has the Bow trait on your check to defeat a monster, recharge a card to add 1d8 if that monster shares a trait other than Basic, Elite, or Veteran with a monster displayed next to this card.
